frontmatter.claim: A break of a multi-week Donchian range persists because risk is repriced slowly: systematic participants scale in over days and trapped counter-positions cover into the move, so the tail of a breakout is fatter than its body. A trailing stop harvests that tail, while a fixed target amputates it and turns a positive-expectancy mechanism into a losing one. Long: close > donchian_hi(100); short: close < donchian_lo(100); stop: ATR 2.0; target: none; trail: arm at 1R, ATR 4.0; max 500 bars.
